_doc: The shared Front Range backdrop: one bake recipe for every track that sees these mountains (PLAN section 3 of tracks/denver-grand-prix, ledger 0096). tools/backdrop_bake.py reads params (every key and its default is in that file's DEFAULTS) and one entry of tracks; tools/backdrop_peak_gate.py reads the same entry's gate block. A track may override any param under its own "params". README.md beside this file says how a track is added.
source: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second, seven staged 1 x 1 degree tiles; provenance.json beside this file

denver-grand-prix.origin_note: PROVISIONAL: the start line (Colfax at Sherman), the horizon study's site. Denver has no track.config.json yet; when it gets its origin, write that origin and its elevation here and bake again.
